retained_initial_failures: The first SQLite fixture run exposed three Windows WinError 32 cleanup failures caused by unclosed sqlite3 connections; contextlib.closing was added to production code and tests, then all three cases passed.
The first Windows PowerShell execution was blocked by its script policy; the read-only script was subsequently executed with a process-only ExecutionPolicy Bypass, without changing machine policy.
The first Compose schema runner used Ajv's default draft; the official schema requires the Ajv 2020 implementation, which then validated successfully.

The first native packager tests exposed a PowerShell 5.1 child inheriting PowerShell 7 module paths, making Get-FileHash unavailable. The packager now hashes through .NET and imports the runtime's built-in ACL module explicitly; all five cases then passed.

An initial WinSW version invocation without a same-name XML failed to find configuration. Generated configurations subsequently loaded with read-only status, reporting NonExistent; no runtime startup is claimed.

Watcher heartbeat tests exposed Windows atomic replacement failing while a concurrent reader briefly held the old file. MoveFileEx now retries only transient sharing/lock/access-denied errors for at most one second, preserving atomic replacement and failing persistent errors.

Independent review found a watcher generation A task could reach a batch loaded against configuration B. The batch now requires watcher generation, same-load config digest and current raw digest to agree before any side effect; a deterministic regression confirms no projection or state creation.

The first graceful-stop regression expected three fixture tasks, while prepareWorker defines two; the assertion was corrected to one interrupted attempt plus two recovered tasks, after state/cooldown assertions had already passed.

Integration database acceptance exposed a SQLite harness DSN mismatch. Independent review found the native packager also used mattn-style parameters; it now uses the glebarez _pragma syntax already present in Compose, and packaging assertions check it.

A subsequent heartbeat test exposed transient Windows sharing violations when reading a concurrently replaced file. Private file reads now retry only sharing/lock violations for a bounded 90 ms; the full 13-root worker suite then passed.
limits: Static Compose validation is not container runtime or full integration E2E.
Registry manifest lookup does not prove image runtime behavior or target platform acceptance.
Native packager tests use synthetic secrets and a known binary fixture; they do not prove actual application startup, graceful shutdown, SCM recovery or Windows Server target behavior.
No production backup, account import, DNS change, release or old-host retirement was performed.
Sub2API administrative electronic confirmation is an operator action; no script acknowledges or bypasses it.
Automatic committed-customer/member reconciliation is connected in the candidate. Actual integration receipts are maintained separately; this file does not claim target signup/model E2E.
Retained obsolete jobs are not automatically canceled. BLOCKED/FAILED jobs stop the batch until operator resolution; revocation in RealYu still blocks external access.
Native candidate processes share LocalService. Production per-service filesystem isolation requires distinct service identities and target ACL/network acceptance.
A local configuration OS lock does not coordinate different hosts/config copies or all callers sharing the same upstream IP.

Internal credit is not a second customer charge or a mirrored RealYu wallet. Unknown add outcomes block by default; finite-window replay requires operator reconciliation, and no absolute exactly-once claim is made.
Credit policy examples require real capacity sizing. Alerts, target service operation and unresolved-intent reconciliation remain operational acceptance requirements.
